title: No One’s Talking About One of The Best Upcoming Anime on Crunchyroll
content: The Spring 2026 anime season is almost over, and the new Summer lineup looks as exciting as ever. 2026 has been one of the best years for anime fans in recent years, with the return of beloved shows such as Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Season 2, Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3, and more.
author: ComicBook

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump’s Anime Revival Confirmed Huge Blunder By Publisher
content: Almost eight years after its cancellation, a forgotten Shonen Jump will be returning with its anime revival this year. Black Torch, written and illustrated by Tsuyoshi Takaki, was serialized in the Jump SQ magazine of Shueisha from 2016 to 2018.
author: ComicBook

title: 37 Years Later, One of The Greatest Manga of All Time Returns With an Exciting Surprise
content: For several decades, the anime and manga industry has been heavily dominated by the Shonen demographic, and most of the mainstream series are intense battle action. A majority of the best-selling manga of all time are also Shonen series, including One Piece, Naruto, Dragon Ball, Demon Slayer, and many more.
author: ComicBook

title: 37 Years Later, Studio Ghibli’s Classic Fantasy Returns With a New Release in Fall 2026
content: Ever since its establishment in 1985, Studio Ghibli has climbed its way to becoming the most iconic studio in Japanese history. The films produced under the banner are famous for their beautifully crafted animated films, rich storytelling, deep emotional impact, and more.

title: Crunchyroll’s Surprise Fantasy Hit Returns With Anticipated New Release Ahead of Season 2
content: 2026 kicks off with the exciting Winter 2026 lineup, which includes the return of major series such as Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3, Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Season 3, Hell’s Paradise Season 3, and many more series.
author: ComicBook

title: Acclaimed Fantasy’s Beloved Character Gets a New Look For Latest Project Ahead of Anime’s Return
content: Kusanagi Mizuho’s beloved shojo manga, Yona of the Dawn , reached its conclusion on December 19th, 2025, after a 16-year-long journey. The historical fantasy manga debuted in 2009 as a monthly series, earning praise for its gorgeous art, unique storytelling, and lovable characters.

title: Yū Nomiya Launches New Koroshiya no Eigyōjutsu Manga on June 15
content: The official X/Twitter account for Kodansha 's Magapoke app revealed on Sunday that Yū Nomiya and Fuji will launch a new manga titled Koroshiya no Eigyōjutsu (An Assassin's Tradecraft) on June 15. Nomiya is writing the story, and Fuji will draw the art.
author: ANN

title: Takashi Sano's Bakudan Manga Ends
content: Takashi Sano 's manga adaptation of Katsuhiro Go 's Bakudan (Bomb) novel ended with its 40th chapter on May 29. The story revolves around a clueless-looking middle-aged man who is brought to Tokyo's Nogata police station for a minor assault-and-battery incident.
author: ANN
